name: amfx-jolts-job-openings-research
description: amFX reproduction (23NOV22 p5): JOLTS total nonfarm job openings 2001-2022. The massive post-COVID spike to 10.7M openings vs 4.4M entering prior recessions is the key counter-argument to the recession thesis. Uses common_economic_indicators JobOpenings.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: JOLTS JOB OPENINGS (23NOV22 p5)
# =============================================================================
# JOLTS total nonfarm job openings, USA, 2001 to Nov 2022.
# The unprecedented spike to 10.7M (vs 4.4M pre-prior recessions)
# was the strongest counter-argument to recession calls.
# Uses common_economic_indicators JobOpenings.
# =============================================================================

# JOLTS Total Nonfarm Job Openings via common indicator
jolts_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.JobOpenings)()
jolts = ffill(jolts_src.result)

# Time index for x-axis
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: JOLTS Job Openings Time Series
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='JOLTS Job Openings: How Large Is the Labor Buffer?',
    category='Labor Market',
    y_axis_label='Job Openings (Thousands)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='JOLTS Job Openings', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=4400, title='Pre-Recession Level (~4.4M)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, jolts)
